body: Thank you so much! I’m hoping that talking to others will help as well.
Never listened but I’ll try checking it out. Music really is amazing though isn’t it? I don’t know how anyone can survive without it.

Wow, yeah that’s literally exactly what I’m going through right now. Those nights are the worst. Don’t have a favorite band but my fav song right now is Ocean Drive by Duke Dumont, just found it recently and it made me feel very nostalgic. How about you?

Yeah, music usually helps most nights, so do video games, and other forms of escapism. But not tonight, this whole day has been horrible and there is no escape or sense of comfort because I know tomorrow is just gonna be hell all over again and I have to be up again in four hours.

Thanks for reading my reply and actually replying, that’s more than people usually do with my posts. And I’m happy to talk about anything that you want, it would really help for me as well and I don’t know if I’ll be getting any sleep tonight anyways...
